Figure 3: Med-R2: a hierarchical evaluation framework for evidence-based reasoning in medical imaging. Representative tasks are organized along a clinical reasoning cascade, and Positive/Neutral/Negative adversarial variants are introduced to assess robustness under misleading cues. Joint QA setting further chains multi-step questions into an end-to-end reasoning path to evaluate cross-level coherence and consistency.
